summary: First end-to-end verification of PACE Running Coach MVP. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed (auth register/login/me, onboarding, plan generation via Claude Sonnet 5 in ~33s, week/session CRUD, complete/uncomplete, home/today, stats, runs CRUD + auto-complete linked session, coach chat AI reply, routes, plus a full fresh-user register->onboarding->plan-generate flow). Frontend: login screen renders, thomas@pace.app/secret123 login succeeds and lands on Home; Home shows Bonjour Thomas + form score 76 + streak + session-of-day; Calendrier shows Week 1/4 Semi-marathon plan with day dots, session cards, completion toggle and week-prev/next arrows (Week 2 loads correctly); Progression shows 5 km / 1 sortie / 25:00 / 6% assiduite / weekly volume chart / dernieres courses; Explorer shows horizontal filter chips (Tous/Footing/Fractionne/Seuil/...) and 6 routes; Profil shows Thomas Martin info card with objectif Semi-marathon 1h40-1h55, race 2026-09-20, Regenerer mon plan / edit / notif switch / logout; Coach chat successfully sent a message and received a well-formed French AI reply from Claude Sonnet 5; logout returns to /auth. No red screens, no page errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected. Only a benign RN-web console warning (props.pointerEvents deprecated).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic-only warning coming from an RN component (likely a TouchableOpacity/Pressable). Non-blocking on web; would be flagged in RN 0.81 warnings on device.

action_items: (Optional) Search the codebase for any component still passing pointerEvents as a prop and migrate to style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }} to silence the deprecation warning.
GPS run tracker (/run/active) was not exercised in this run because it requires real device GPS; consider adding a lightweight web fallback or a testID-based mocked path to keep automated coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI (Starlette). Consider migrating to a lifespan context manager. Not blocking.

generate_plan does delete_many on sessions before insert_many; if the LLM call succeeds but insert_many fails partway the user is left with no sessions. Acceptable for MVP but a transactional rewrite would be safer.
public_user does not expose user_id typed shape (frontend seems to only need email/name/onboarding_completed/profile so it's fine).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (login, home, calendar, progression, explore, profile, coach, logout)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_<uuid>@pace.app user created + a full 4-week plan by TestFreshUserFlow (LLM-generated, ~30-40s). Also created and removed one test run linked to a session for thomas@pace.app (session was un-completed at the end of the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is https://running-coach-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com and the frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_pace_api.py and pass in ~66s (Claude coach chat and plan-generate account for ~50s). Coach chat and plan generation are real LLM calls -- allow >=60s. Login credentials: thomas@pace.app / secret123 (has active 4-week semi-marathon plan). Bottom nav is a 5-tab layout (Accueil/Calendrier/Progression/Explorer/Profil). Coach screen is a standalone route (/coach) opened from Home via home-coach-cta. GPS /run/active was not exercised; expects real device.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found -- MVP is functional end-to-end.
